title: Maria Tan: Late nights, household objects, & the inextinguishable light of art
desc:
Maria Tan’s typical day in Singapore starts at 8 a.m. with running, Pilates and strength training. She goes to the studio at 10 a.m., working until evening.
In her past life in New York, she painted often into the early hours of the morning. In Singapore, she had to adapt to the rhythm of the city. But in both places, Maria conjures vast imaginary spaces and lights fantastic.
